thread:
olivia (PM): quick pulse — M2 milestone check. two small ships + one slip. please drop current owner status, any CRs outstanding, and blockers. pinging @sam @lee @maria for updates

sam (Eng): routing-v2 canary merged into staging earlier today. smoke looked good. CR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/routing/pull/412  :thumbsup:

lee (Eng infra): autoscale-rule work slipped — we hit an API contract mismatch with infra-config service. owner: lee. ETA if api bump lands: end of week. blocking: infra-config deploy (needs @kai approval)

maria (ML Eng): shipped embedding-cache optimization to prod canary. noticed intermittent CI flake on batch tests — opening follow-up PR to tighten timeouts. owner: maria. CR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/embeddings/pull/87

ashley (Product): thanks — what's our canary size for routing-v2 and rollback criteria?

olivia (PM): canary = 5% traffic. rollback triggers: p50 latency +30ms over baseline OR error-rate >0.5% sustained for 10m. also manual rollback on semantic regression alerts.

kai (SRE): noted. need deploy window (prefer low-traffic hours). I'll bump infra-config api if lee sends the contract diff. also linking runbook: https://wiki/redwood/runbooks/deploys :eyes:

sam (Eng): reviewers pinged for CR 412: @maria @kai @lee. one operational blocker: model-weights quota on the dedicated pool — getting throttled 2x during the canary. jordan (finance) looping in for quota change or temporary exception.

jordan (Finance): I can approve a temporary quota bump if eng provides the expected token/sec and duration. please post numbers here (rough is fine).

sam (Eng): rough numbers: peak 1200 tokens/sec, expected for canary window ~30m, entire canary ~24h to ramp. will add a short blurb in the PR description.

lee (Eng infra): dropping the minimal diff I need from eng to greenlight infra-config deploy:
```json
{ "new_endpoint": "/v2/config", "response": { "autoscale_min": "int", "autoscale_max": "int" } }
```

maria (ML Eng): +1 on quota bump while we validate. will run an additional stability job tomorrow morning.

olivia (PM): action items:
- sam: add token/sec + canary schedule to PR and link rollback dashboard (due today)
- lee: share api diff + ETA to kai (today)
- kai: confirm deploy window + watch rotation (tomorrow AM)
- jordan: temporary quota decision (today)
- maria: follow-up PR for CI timeouts + stability job (tomorrow)

deploy-bot: deploy queued for routing-v2 -> staging at 2026-04-15T02:00Z (initiated by @sam)

ashley (Product): sounds good. if we hit slip on autoscale, prioritize revert path and communicate to payment teams (downtime risk low but FYI).

olivia (PM): thanks everyone — i'll compile a one-line update for the exec sync after jordan confirms quota. ping here for any changes. :calendar:
